description: Citizen town halls and AMAs (ask-me-anything sessions) that officials hold on Power Players: type ('town_hall' or 'ama'), id, title, a short description, topic, the host official with a link, start and end time, status, format (virtual or in person, venue), registration for town halls, question counts and the page link. status is 'upcoming' (default), 'past' or 'all'. Filter by one person (kind and id, from search_people) or a two-letter state. Meeting links and passwords are never returned; people register on the event page. Use get_town_hall for the full details and the answered questions, and the account connector's ask_town_hall_question to ask in an AMA.
name: list_town_halls
title: List town halls and AMAs
